processes.name: game client
processes.description: The player-facing client used to launch and play the game.
processes.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines.

processes.name: lobby
processes.description: The matchmaking component that sets up matches and hands them over to game servers.
processes.source_excerpt: The lobby reads the player database to set up a match, and hands the match over to the game servers.

processes.name: game server
processes.description: A server that handles matches and reads and writes player and statistics data.
processes.source_excerpt: the game servers read and write the stats database during and after a match

trust_boundaries.name: player machine
trust_boundaries.description: A machine owned or controlled by a player and outside the organisation's control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Players run our game client on their own machines. We do not control those machines.

trust_boundaries.name: production network
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's production network containing the lobby and game servers.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network

assumptions.basis: The lobby must be reachable from wherever a player is and is described as exposed.
The game servers must be reachable from wherever a player is and are described as exposed.

assumptions.assumption: The player database has confidential data.
assumptions.basis: The database contains player accounts, which are personal data.
